response:
The issue has been identified and fixed.

### Root Cause
In [`NumberUtils.createNumber(String)`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/lang_1_group_c_fix/src/main/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/math/NumberUtils.java#L466-L475), hexadecimal strings were assigned numeric types based purely on digit count without discounting leading zeros or accounting for unsigned hex values where the highest bit is set (e.g., `0x80000000` to `0xFFFFFFFF` exceeding `Integer.MAX_VALUE`, and `0x8000000000000000` to `0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF` exceeding `Long.MAX_VALUE`). This caused `NumberFormatException` when decoding values exceeding the signed range and resulted in incorrect type selections when leading zeros were present.

### Solution
Updated [`NumberUtils.java`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/lang_1_group_c_fix/src/main/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/math/NumberUtils.java#L466-L480) to strip leading zeros when counting significant hex digits and check if the first significant digit exceeds `'7'` at the 8-digit and 16-digit boundaries to select the appropriate numeric type (`Integer`, `Long`, or `BigInteger`).

### Verification & Patch
- All Cucumber scenarios in [requirement.feature](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/lang_1_group_c_fix/requirement.feature) passed with:
  ```bash
  export TZ='America/Los_Angeles'; mvn test -Dtest=CucumberTest
  ```
- Saved the focused patch to [`negative_fix.patch`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/lang_1_group_c_fix/negative_fix.patch).
